name: any-app-screenshot
description: Deterministic Playwright capture of every screen and state of any web app, per app profile (apps/<app-id>/) and device type, with git-diff + DOM-fingerprint change detection, nav discovery and doc generation. Real accounts are read-only; only a verified dummy account in its own test tenant may write.

scripts.test: node -r ts-node/register -r ./src/__tests__/setup.ts --test src/__tests__/glob.test.ts src/__tests__/fingerprint.test.ts src/__tests__/flow-loader.test.ts src/__tests__/flow-schema.test.ts src/__tests__/record-convert.test.ts src/__tests__/security-policy.test.ts src/__tests__/app-profile.test.ts src/__tests__/write-gates.test.ts src/__tests__/write-gates-e2e.test.ts src/__tests__/evidence-unit.test.ts src/__tests__/evidence-capture.test.ts src/__tests__/evidence-index.test.ts
